thought.text: Media upload worked and returned an mxc URI — that confirms MinIO write path. Let me verify the round-trip download and the admin dashboard SSO flow.

reasoning_content:
The Matrix sync, public rooms, and media upload are all working — the media upload successfully returned an mxc URI, confirming that MinIO is being used for media storage. Next, I'll verify whether the uploaded media can be downloaded (round-trip test), check MinIO bucket listing using mc with the app credentials, and test the admin dashboard SSO flow (logging in as kai via the admin OIDC client, which should be nebu-admin or admin).

I'll do the following:
1. Download the uploaded media to verify the round-trip (this verifies MinIO read + write).
2. Check MinIO bucket listing using mc with the app credentials.
3. Admin SSO: GET /admin/login → find the SSO link → OIDC → log in as kai → dashboard 200.

action.command:
ALEXTOK=$(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/alex_token.txt)
echo "=== media download round-trip ==="
curl -sS -m 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ALEXTOK" "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/media/v3/download/localhost/CuoEwzvC8AE6TE0L4S0Zkg" -o /tmp/nebu-validate/dl.png -w 'HTTP:%{http_code} size:%{size_download}\n'
file /tmp/nebu-validate/dl.png 2>/dev/null || ls -la /tmp/nebu-validate/dl.png
echo "=== MinIO bucket check via mc (app creds) ==="
AK=$(cat /workspace/.secrets/minio_app_access_key); SK=$(cat /workspace/.secrets/minio_app_secret_key)
docker run --rm --network host -e "mc" minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z mc ls "s3://$AK:$SK@127.0.0.1:9000/" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "--- objects in nebu-media (first 5) ---"
docker run --rm --network host minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z mc ls --recursive "s3://$AK:$SK@127.0.0.1:9000/nebu-media" 2>&1 | head -5
